# Numbered Round 1 paper slip

Retain the original. Enter its evidence reference during independent reconciliation.

| Field | Record |
|---|---|
| Round database ID / attempt identity | |
| Unique slip number | |
| Team code / assigned desk | |
| Mission public ID | |
| Official timestamp with timezone | |
| Remaining active time at desk | |
| Four-digit answer, preserving zeros | |
| Evaluated / blocked without evaluation | |
| Blocked reason, if applicable | |
| Wrong / accepted result, if evaluated | |
| Desk recorder | |
| Independent verifier | |
| Clock check reference | |
| Original slip/scan reference | |

Evaluate at most once per team/mission per 60 active seconds. Record blocked attempts too. Do not score before the approved official paper start or after the cutoff. A second accepted answer never awards another point. Reconcile chronologically using the original official time.
